entities.name: Charles Joseph, comte de Flahaut
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Auguste Charles Joseph de Flahaut de La Billarderie, Comte de Flahaut was a French general during the Napoleonic Wars, a senator, and later in his life, a French ambassador to the Court of St James's. He had a son with Napoleon's stepdaughter, Hortense de Beauharnais.
